description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Drinking Water and Catchment Safety By-laws of Thumpane, Pradeshiya Sabha Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, Pallepola Pradeshiya Sabha, Pasbage Korale Pradeshiya Sabha and Gampola Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the enactment of "Drinking Water and Water Catchment Safety By-Laws" for the Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha. It establishes new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for water safety, including licensing procedures, prohibited activities around water sources, and operational standards. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it creates new subsidiary legislation under the authority of existing acts (Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987 and Provincial Councils Act No. 12 of 1989). While it mentions the Governor's authority, it does not focus on government structure/personnel changes but rather on creating new regulatory provisions.
